title: Identification of a novel immunosenescence-related genes and integrative analyses in patients with psoriasis.
authors: Liu, Yiran; Li, Ding; Yu, Xiaoqian; Li, Xiaoyuan
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过生物信息学和机器学习分析银屑病中免疫衰老相关基因，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，仅边缘相关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Immunosenescence, characterized by age-related changes in the immune system, may contribute to the onset and progression of psoriasis, a condition whose incidence increases with age and often requires intensified medication in older patients. METHODS: This study utilized bioinformatics analyses to identify differentially expressed immunosenescence-related genes in psoriasis patients from the GEO database. Enrichment, correlation, and interaction network analyses were conducted to explore their involvement in immune and inflammation pathways. Machine learning models were employed to predict psoriasis onset and validated using external datasets. Patient stratification based on gene expression patterns assessed differential responses to biologic inhibitors targeting specific genes. RESULTS: Immunosenescence emerged as a significant factor in psoriasis pathogenesis, with genes such as BACH2 potentially influencing T cell activation and disease outcomes. Lower BACH2 expression levels were associated with poorer treatment responses in psoriasis patients. CONCLUSIONS: This study sheds light on immunosenescence-related mechanisms in psoriasis, suggesting BACH2 as a potential disease diagnosis biomarker. Further research into BACH2's role in psoriasis pathophysiology is warranted to advance tailored treatment strategies.
abstract_zh: 背景：免疫衰老（immunosenescence）以免疫系统随年龄相关变化为特征，可能促进银屑病（psoriasis）的发生与进展，该病发病率随年龄增长而增加，且老年患者常需强化药物治疗。方法：本研究利用生物信息学分析，从GEO数据库中鉴定银屑病患者中差异表达的免疫衰老相关基因。通过富集分析、相关性分析和相互作用网络分析，探讨这些基因在免疫和炎症通路中的作用。采用机器学习模型预测银屑病发病，并使用外部数据集进行验证。基于基因表达模式的患者分层评估了针对特定基因的生物抑制剂的不同治疗反应。结果：免疫衰老在银屑病发病机制中成为重要因素，其中如BACH2等基因可能影响T细胞激活和疾病结局。BACH2表达水平较低与银屑病患者较差的治疗反应相关。结论：本研究揭示了银屑病中免疫衰老相关机制，提示BACH2可作为潜在的疾病诊断生物标志物。进一步研究BACH2在银屑病病理生理中的作用，有助于推进个体化治疗策略。
